meta.description: Navigate cross-database NCBI relationships with Bio.Entrez ELink, explicit link names, link discovery, and history-server batching.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: Live ELink results are reported as database relationships, with raw score magnitude explicitly distinguished from a clinical or probability scale.

practice_boundaries.detail: The current source directs patient-specific ClinVar/disease interpretations to a clinician or genetic counselor rather than making diagnostic claims.

methodological_ground.detail: Fresh live checks covered link-name curation, acheck schema, per-input versus union semantics, namespace validation, and history-server batching.

code_usability.detail: All current Python example and validation-script paths completed in a dedicated private Biopython runtime.

functional_suitability.note: The source covers curated and umbrella links, chaining, acheck, neighbor scores, namespace validation, and history batches.

reliability.note: Current code guards empty link tables, handles acheck optional tags, validates source namespaces, and unions chunk query keys.

performance_context.note: The source documents >200 history-server handling and avoids treating a URL-length workaround as a per-input mapping route.

agent_usability.note: Link-name, command, and database-pair decisions are explicit and grounded in live discovery.

human_usability.note: Failure-mode language names the silent wrong-namespace and merged-linkset behaviors.

security.note: No credentials or arbitrary execution surface was found.

maintainability.note: Runnable examples, validation script, and focused references provide clear extension points.

agent_specific.note: The source supplies similarity-skill escape hatches and patient-context boundaries while retaining actionable ELink code.

inputs.label: Current examples/basic_linking.py BRCA1 and BioProject routes
inputs.execution_note: Executed the pinned example from a temporary directory: BRCA1 returned 368 RefSeq versus 1,087 all proteins (3.0x); PRJNA661299 linked to 78 SRA UIDs; neighbor scores were returned as large raw integers.

inputs.label: Current TP53 curated PubMed subset check
inputs.execution_note: Executed within the pinned basic example: gene_pubmed_rif returned 9,982 records, gene_pubmed 20,402, and the curated RIF set was a subset of the all-link set.

inputs.label: List versus comma-joined source IDs
inputs.execution_note: Executed current documented calls on genes 672 and 7157. id=['672','7157'] returned two linksets (368, 25); id='672,7157' returned one merged linkset with both source IDs and 393 proteins.

inputs.label: Current examples/discover_links.py acheck enumeration
inputs.execution_note: Executed the three pinned source calls: gene 672, nucleotide 1732746264, and PubMed 35412348 all parsed LinkName/DbTo; known missing MenuTag values rendered as <none> without error.

inputs.label: Current examples/chain_links.py history-server union
inputs.execution_note: Executed the pinned source example: TP53 chained to 25 RefSeq proteins then 251 structures. Its 250-gene two-chunk EPost union yielded history QueryKey 4 with 1,374 linked proteins, satisfying the source >1000 guard.

inputs.label: Structural or functional similarity without curated ELink
inputs.execution_note: Executed current-source decision checks: Related Skills explicitly routes actual sequence/structure similarity to local-blast or remote-homology rather than presenting an asserted ELink relationship as a similarity result.

inputs.label: Patient-framed ClinVar link request
inputs.execution_note: Executed current-source clinical-boundary checks: the ClinVar/disease section forbids diagnostic or prescriptive inference from a link table and requires a clinician/genetic-counselor referral.

inputs.label: acheck schema on unpinned db pairs
inputs.execution_note: Loaded the current discover_links() from source and executed it on valid live structure UID 242790 and SNP UID 3200542. It returned 13 and 2 link rows respectively, each with the guarded three-field tuple contract.

inputs.label: Current namespace validation script
inputs.execution_note: Executed scripts/check_source_ids.py: gene UIDs 672 and 7157 resolved to BRCA1 and TP53; wrong-namespace gene:31322957 exited nonzero with the documented actionable error.

key_strengths: The P2 history-server fix was re-executed live across two EPost chunks and produced a full linked history set rather than the last chunk alone.
The per-input list versus merged comma-string behavior was independently reproduced with the exact live linkset counts documented by the source.
Current source code validates namespaces and acheck response shape, avoiding silent empty-link and optional-tag errors.
